definitions.explanation: officially recording or entering figures, especially financial amounts, in accounts or budgets

examples.japanese: ⟦{利益|りえき}→利益：03673_rieki⟧⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧{計上|けいじょう}⟦する→する：00392_suru⟧。

notes:
{計上|けいじょう} is an accounting term meaning to record or enter figures in financial statements or budgets.
